messages.subject: reset input, on button click
parts:
I can't get enough of shiny - so, thank you VERY much for maintaining this wonderful R library :)

Here's my question...

ui.R:
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
  uiOutput("number_input")
  actionButton("reset_button", "Reset")
))


server.R:
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$number_input <- renderUI({
    input$reset_button
    numericInput("number", "Number:", 1)
  })
})

... I am trying to build an interface where, for example, the user can enter data into input fields, and when he/she clicks a button (in my example here: input$reset_button) then the inputs ?reset? back to their default values (which is 1 for the numericInput in my example here).

I've done this before, but it was by accident and I was not particularly trying to make it happen at the time, but I couldn't figure out exactly how it was happening. As far as I can tell, to do this, you may have to set things up so that when the user clicks, there is a reaction that removes the input$number field (makes it NULL) for a moment only to define it anew (which then defaults to having a value of 1).

Is there a standard practice for implementing this sort of behavior in shiny?
